main_text.l: Artes quæ à Romanis & Athe-niensibus improbatæ. 182.
Assa cella. 219.13.18. Assa vo-ce recitare. [illegible, ~7 letters]

page.notes: Lower part of the page is cut off; the final entry "Assa vo-ce recitare" and the right column are incomplete. The Greek in "Aidetti. Vide ..." and "ἀναιδηνία" is only partly legible; the Greek word after "Vide" is illegible. "matena" may be "materia" in print; reading uncertain. "Aniolorsi" and the figures after it are doubtful. Right-column numbers and the hyphenated "Athe-niensibus" are copied as seen. Since the right column is set in two parts, the lines are shown side by side as printed. Greek entries "ἀνοίας" and "ἡμιψευδομένων" and the Greek in "aulæa" are doubtful and marked. "ex Besle" is uncertain. The "d'Assaut" line may read differently in the scan.
